card.name: Inside medical terms before syndrome or infection
card.fires_on: The word just before the end of a medical condition name, such as 'tunnel' in carpal tunnel, 'osis' in thrombosis, 'ear' in middle ear, or 'neurop' in neuropathy. It fires where the rest of the name is predictable.
